allow: Bash: git add / git commit / git push to origin main, run by a scheduled Claude Code cloud routine in this repo (EA Daily Briefing, EA Sheets Digest, EA Weekly Cleanup, or similar executive-assistant automation) to save its own generated report file (e.g. under executive-assistant/reports/) or a small generated JSON snapshot it produced this run.
